study_title: Replication of the Posada and Crandall 2001 Benchmark Suite

reference.citation: Posada, D., & Crandall, K. A. (2001). Evaluation of methods for detecting recombination from DNA sequences: Computer simulations. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 98(24), 13757-13762.

data_provenance.og_data_note: Original alignments were not archived in public repositories in 2001. Regenerated strictly from published specifications using Hudson's coalescent model and Seq-Gen Markov substitution.
data_provenance.policy: ALWAYS use original alignments when archived; otherwise regenerate strictly following the published procedure.
